text: Why are airplane tires NOT filled with air?
sayTts: [mischievously] Why are airplane tires... NOT filled with air?

text: Over 60 tons, scorching brakes… and one gas that changes everything.
say: Over sixty tons, scorching brakes… and one gas that changes everything.
sayTts: [curious] Over sixty tons, scorching brakes... and one gas that changes everything.

text: Each tire runs at 200 psi: six times your car's.
say: Each tire runs at two hundred P S I: six times your car's.
sayTts: [thoughtful] Each tire runs at two hundred P-S-I: six times your car's.

text: And no, you can't blow into it: it's nitrogen, under pressure.
sayTts: [chuckles] And no, you can't just blow into it: it's nitrogen, under pressure.

text: Someone asked: isn't air mostly nitrogen already?
sayTts: [sarcastic] Someone asked: isn't air mostly nitrogen already?

comment.question: Wait, isn't air mostly nitrogen already? 🤔

text: Yep: 78 %. The problem is the other 21: oxygen.
say: Yep: seventy-eight percent. The problem is the other twenty-one: oxygen.
sayTts: [thoughtful] Yep: seventy-eight percent. The problem is the other twenty-one... oxygen.

text: When braking, the rubber heats up and gives off gases.
sayTts: [dramatic] When braking, the rubber heats up... and gives off gases.

text: Add oxygen, and those gases can ignite… and the tire can explode.
sayTts: [gasps] Add oxygen, and those gases can ignite... and the tire can explode.

text: In 1986, in Mexico, a tire full of air blew up mid-flight.
say: In nineteen eighty-six, in Mexico, a tire full of air blew up mid-flight.
sayTts: [whispers] In nineteen eighty-six, in Mexico, a tire full of air... blew up mid-flight.

text: That's why the rule is under 5 % oxygen inside.
say: That's why the rule is under five percent oxygen inside.
sayTts: [dramatic] That's why the rule is: under five percent oxygen inside.

text: Tag your friend who still inflates tires with their own lungs.
sayTts: [excited] Tag your friend who still inflates tires... with their own lungs.

text: See you next time! Hit like and follow for more.
sayTts: [warmly] See you next time! Hit like and follow for more.
